description: Short real-run smoke for 31_dinov3: pretrain -> encoder.pt -> linear_eval, one epoch on tiny real-shaped ImageFolder data. Discovered and driven by tests/test_real_run_smoke.py and bin/matrix-run.py (docs/REAL_RUN_VERIFICATION.md steps 2-3). Lives in the method's own directory so no shared file names a method. This is a ViT method (DINOv3's own ViT-B/16 with registers + RoPE, no timm): train.img_size and train.global_size (64) and train.local_size (32) stay divisible by the patch size 16, train.n_local_crops is shrunk for the multi-crop forward, and the temperature/LR warmups are zeroed so the one-epoch schedule is well defined.
